list.item: What is the value of \(c\) in the expression \(x^2−20x+ c\)?
If \(x^2−20x+ c\) is factored to be \((x\; -\;\;\;)^2\), what is the missing value of the factored form of this expression?

problem.para: Enter the missing value of the factored form.

list.item: What is the value of \(c\) in the expression \(x^2+bx+ c\)?

problem.para: Write down your answer, then select the solution button to compare your work.

section.para: Notice that finding the value of \(c\) helped to create a perfect square trinomial. This is called completing the square.

div.para: When you approach life with intellectual humility, you open your mind to learning. You are able to learn from opposing views and have more constructive discussions, even when you disagree.
Think about yourself. Are these statements true for you?

list.item: I question my own opinions, positions, and viewpoints because they could be wrong.
In the face of conflicting evidence, I am open to changing my opinions.

div.para: Don’t worry if none of these statements are true for you. Developing this trait takes time. Your first step starts today!
